description.zh-CN: Mozilla 出品的单文件 LLM 运行器：一个可执行文件直接跑本地大模型，零安装、免配置；配一个 GGUF 权重文件就是一个完整离线聊天服务。
description.en: Single-file LLM runner from Mozilla — one executable runs local models with zero installation; pair it with a GGUF weights file and you have a full offline chat server.

runtime.note: One self-contained executable (llama.cpp + Cosmopolitan Libc), no installation. Requirements from official docs (docs.mozilla.ai/llamafile/reference/support): Windows 10+ AMD64 only (x86 CPU needs AVX), macOS 12+ / kernel 23.1 (GPU backend only on Apple Silicon), ARM64 CPUs need ARMv8a. Windows limits executables to 4GB, so use the runner with an external GGUF for large models.

local.label: Local GGUF models (free, offline, no key)

recommendedModels.name: Qwen3.5 0.8B (official quickstart llamafile)
recommendedModels.note: Smallest official pre-built, runs out of the box

local.notes: llamafile itself has no key configuration — models come either as pre-built .llamafile files (download & run) or as external GGUF via -m (official quickstart). configTarget is AiBOX's CONFIG write location (default ~/.config/<appId>/<appId>.json5), not a llamafile-native file; TODO real-machine confirmation.

upgrade.notes: Check = local --version against the tag the daily probe records; upgrade = re-run the install route (it overwrites the single file in place).

steps: Optional: remove ~/.llamafile (GPU backend libraries cached there) and any .llamafile/GGUF model files you downloaded — these are yours to keep if you want to reinstall later
uninstall.notes: Models are usually stored wherever you downloaded them (outside these paths); check ~/.llamafile — versioned GPU libraries live there (official docs). No system services, no background daemons.

risk.onUninstall: The runner and any model files you kept in its folders are deleted, and cached GPU libraries under ~/.llamafile are removed — move your .llamafile/GGUF models somewhere safe first. / 运行器与放在其目录里的模型文件会被删除，~/.llamafile 下的 GPU 库缓存也会清掉——请先把 .llamafile/GGUF 模型挪到安全位置。
